statement: For a root-sensitive terminal quantity decomposed at a strict cutoff, a local path statistic can avoid directly containing the endpoint only by leaving a complementary suffix. If the complement is root-negligible, a strong local bound transports back to the endpoint; if it is not controlled, the local bound does not glue. The decomposition by itself therefore does not reduce total obligation strength.
boundaries: Algebraic/representation obstruction only; it is not an impossibility theorem for every analytic statistic.
A different statistic may exploit arithmetic structure that jointly controls local and complement pieces without equivalent root strength.
Ambient path DifferenceWitness does not establish target arithmetic attainability.
